title: platform-checklist: add `studio-authoring.picklist-bound-select`, the acceptance item of objectui#10202 (a package picklist bound from the designer: forms offer its options, inline options are refused, an object with a bound field saves)
body:
Routed by the objectui `domain:ui` seat 1 (`session_015W8GBu6sBiqus2L2xjMsAL`) as the cross-repo half of objectstack-ai/objectui#10202. Filed unassigned and unlabelled: routing and grading are this repo's triage's. ⛔ Not a claim.

## Why

- **The ruling.** objectui#10202 is the objectui half of objectstack-ai/objectstack#18164 phase 2. The director ruling `6006062645` there (batch #280 item 1, letter A′, on the maintainer's order) scopes it to:
  - (a) "use picklist" in the object designer's select-field editor;
  - (b) the field save path dropping the served, resolved `options` when `picklist` is set;
  - (c) a read-only picklist page;
  - (d) "one studio-authoring checklist item".
- **Why it is filed here.** (d) lives in this repo (`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/studio-authoring.json`), outside the objectui lane, so the seat carries it here instead of editing objectstack from an objectui card.
- **The objectui work.** (a)–(c) are in PR objectstack-ai/objectui#11669 (head `3114a9f`), being landed through objectui's merge queue as this card is filed.
- **How the item was drafted.** The card's dev drafted the entry below and matched it to what that PR built and measured live, on objectstack `main` `faf8dce4` with a local, uncommitted picklist fixture:
  - **before:** `422 INVALID_METADATA` at `fields.tier.options`;
  - **after:** `200` in both designers;
  - both objects' forms offer the list's options, the extension's included.
- **Its fixture.** The stock showcase declares no picklist, so the fixture line says so.
